blocks.text: Black Iron Quantum AI (Private) Limited possesses direct, verifiable skillset and delivery experience in providing AI, Data Science, and technical/functional training — spanning digital products, technical software and tools, coding languages, AI, big data, machine learning, data analytics, data science, data mining, cybersecurity, and data governance — to audiences at senior leadership, middle management, and individual-contributor levels. This experience is anchored in the credentials of the firm's Founder and Chairman, Zulfiqar Ali Mir (Ph.D. Econometrics), summarised below.

rows: Ph.D., Econometrics; M.Phil., Economics & Finance; MBA, HRM; Management Accountant (ICMAP).
Founder & Chairman, Black Iron Quantum AI (Private) Limited; Research Analyst / LLM Trainer, USA — clients include Apple, Meta, and Anthropic; Research Fellow, Social Policy Resource Center (SPRC)
